info.title: Get Bestselling Videos
info.description: Get the top 100 performing videos of the target date range

get.description: Get the top 100 performing videos of the target date range

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The reference date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in the shop's registered timezone. The query will calculate data backwards from this specified date based on the time_slot parameter (e.g., if time_slot is 7D, it returns data for the 7 days ending on this date). This date is inclusive. The maximum query range depends on the time_slot parameter.

parameters.name: time_slot
parameters.description:
Specifies the query time range. Supported values are:

- 1D: query data for 1 day

- 7D: query data for 7 days

- 30D: query data for 30 days

This field determines the maximum range that can be queried using the date field.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency for monetary values. Use USD for US dollars or LOCAL for the local currency where the shop is registered.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

views.description: Accumulative number of video views since the video was published.

likes.description: Accumulative number of video likes since the video was published.

comments.description: Accumulative number of video comments since the video was published.

shares.description: Accumulative number of video shares since the video was published.

product_id.description: Product ID in the product anchor. Excludes deactivated and sold-out products.

product_name.description: Product name list of product anchors. Exclude deactivated and soldout products.

product_infos.description: List of product anchors associated with the video, including product IDs and product names. Excludes deactivated and sold-out products.

publish_time.description: Publish time of the video, unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00).

videos.description: List of bestselling video records for the target date range.
